data.long_meaning: In the Hebrew Bible, Leah was the daughter of Laban and the older sister of Rachel. Leah’s name means ‘weary’ or ‘tired’ because she was ‘worn out’ from bearing so many children after Rachel, who was favored by Jacob. Despite this, Leah’s perseverance and faithfulness are commended in the Bible. Leahmarie is a beautiful name for a daughter, reminding us of the faithfulness and perseverance of Leah.
data.etymology: Leahmarie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Weary, Tired, Rest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Leahmarie total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
